verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents a REST v3 API reference with per-endpoint descriptions and says it publishes machine-readable Swagger/OpenAPI specs. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer, a 'try it' console or runnable examples, so the story's actual capability is unevidenced. A static reference plus a spec that users could load into their own tools is only adjacent support, and the probes at guessed OpenAPI paths returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
